This '''Imperial officer''' commanded the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Battle over Coruscant]] in late [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], in which the ''Executor'' destroyed the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'', killing [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
